claim_summary: For the two-coordinate diffusion \(dX=(Q-X)dt+\sqrt{2}\,dW\), \(dQ=g(X-Q)dt+\sqrt{2g}\,dB\) with rate-\(r\) Poisson resets of \(X\) alone, the correlation of pre-reset positions separated by \(m\ge1\) reset events is \(\rho_m=(r+2g+2)(r+1)^{m-1}/[2(r+g+1)^{m+1}]\). For \(m\ge2\), this correlation has an interior unique maximizer in \(r>0\) exactly if \(g>3/[2(m-1)]\); otherwise it decreases strictly. In the interior case the maximizer is \(r_m^*=[g(m-4)-4+\sqrt{g^2m^2+4(g+1)(2g+1)}]/2\), and for fixed \(g>0\), \(r_m^*/m\to g\) and \(m\rho_m(r_m^*,g)\to 1/(2eg)\).
scientific_integrity: Stationary moments and conditional regression are established techniques. The proof is analytical; exact-rational checks and finite simulation provide independent bounded verification. Neither full priority uniqueness nor independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Instantaneous independent exponential probe-only resets; two linear coupled Gaussian coordinates; unreset bath; stationary pre-reset event sampling. No assertion for arbitrary viscoelastic baths, non-Poisson resets, fixed physical-time observation, or finite-duration returns.
title: Optimal reset cadence and the long-lag envelope of viscoelastic excursion memory
